text:
Sophie: Heads up — Acme reported their daily usage exports are off by one day around midnight. They say entries between 00:00-04:59 are being attributed to the previous day.
Manny: Hmm, do we know their org timezone?
Sophie: Their org is set to America/Los_Angeles in Console. Export CSV timestamps look like UTC-ish though.
Priya: Can you attach a sample CSV?
Sophie: Here, small snippet from export:
```csv
account_id,timestamp,model,tokens
acme-123,2024-06-12T04:35:21Z,gpt-4-rc,120
acme-123,2024-06-12T03:12:08Z,gpt-4-rc,45
acme-123,2024-06-12T06:01:00Z,gpt-4-rc,200
```
Sophie: Those first two lines are showing up under 'June 11' in their daily CSV view.
Jake: That looks like exports are using UTC and then we render by local day boundary (midnight local) incorrectly. If their timezone is PDT (UTC-7) then 04:35Z should be 21:35 previous day — that matches.
Liz: Right — but Console UI shows days based on org timezone. Exports should do the same. Possible cause: export job uses system timezone or forgets to convert from UTC when grouping.
Manny: Can someone repro? Steps I tried locally: 1) Set org timezone to America/Los_Angeles; 2) generate events around UTC midnight; 3) call /v1/usage/export CSV. I see timestamps in Z and grouping done server-side without timezone shift.
Priya: Repro confirmed on staging. Export job (batch-worker) does grouping by truncating timestamp to date using server local tz (UTC) instead of org timezone.
analytics-bot: FYI metric: export-service error rate no change, jobs running on node group export-workers-2.
Manny: Quick mitigation: convert exported timestamps to org timezone strings before writing CSV and add note in CSV header about timezone. Can we patch and hotfix?
Jake: I can push a small change to export-service to apply tz conversion using org settings. Will add a flag to preserve original UTC column too.
Sophie: Customer asked for corrected CSVs for last 3 days. Priya can we re-export and send?
Priya: Yes — once hotfix is up I can run backfill export for acme-123 (range 2024-06-09 to 2024-06-12) and upload to their support ticket.
Jake: deploying patch now to the export-workers pool.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: export-service v2.3.1-hotfix -> export-workers (shard 2).
Manny: Add unit test for timezone conversion and integration test that compares UI daily totals vs export totals for sample orgs.
Jake: Deployment completed.
deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded: export-service v2.3.1-hotfix at 1718205865.
Jake: Hotfix includes: - convert timestamps to org timezone for CSV grouping - add original_utc_timestamp column - CSV header states timezone - add unit test
Priya: Running backfill for acme-123 now. Will DM the ticket when done.
Priya: Backfill complete, uploaded corrected CSV to support ticket #2489. Customer confirmed numbers match their expectations :thumbsup:
Sophie: Closing loop — customer happy. Follow-up todo: migrate grouping logic to store-agnostic UTC + render on read, and add an audit log for export timezone used.
Manny: Filed follow-up GH issue #4521 for long-term fix.
Sophie: Thanks all!
